exercise.title: Clap on the beat
exercise.why: When your clap lands exactly on the click, the click hides under it, so the metronome tells you when you are on the beat.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the metronome. Clap once on every click, and listen for the click hiding under your clap.
Keep going until your hands move with the click and no longer after it.

Press Play below to start the metronome, and clap on every click again.
Once the click hides under your clap, try another tempo. Use the Tempo selector below to change the tempo, then press Play to start the metronome again.
When you change the tempo, the gap between the clicks changes, and your clap still lands on the click.

Press Play below to start the drums. The metronome is off now, so clap where you feel the beat.
Then press Click below to switch the metronome on, and check that your claps land on it.
